keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Hassani Dotson (Seattle Sounders FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Penalty saved. Albert Rusnák (Seattle Sounders FC) right footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Rafael Cabral (Real Salt Lake).
Dominik Marczuk (Real Salt Lake) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Seattle Sounders FC 1, Real Salt Lake 0. Albert Rusnák (Seattle Sounders FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Sebastian Gomez.
Morgan Guilavogui (Real Salt Lake) is shown the yellow card.
Kim Kee-Hee (Seattle Sounders FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Seattle Sounders FC 1, Real Salt Lake 0.
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. Zach Booth replaces Dominik Marczuk.
Delay in match because of an injury Morgan Guilavogui (Real Salt Lake).
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. Lukas Engel replaces Kobi Henry.
Goal! Seattle Sounders FC 1, Real Salt Lake 1. Morgan Guilavogui (Real Salt Lake) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Sergi Solans.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Seattle Sounders FC).
Delay in match because of an injury Morgan Guilavogui (Real Salt Lake).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Kalani Kossa-Rienzi replaces Kim Kee-Hee.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Paul Arriola replaces Sebastian Gomez.
Cristian Roldan (Seattle Sounders FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. Samuel Junqua replaces Juan Manuel Sanabria.
Delay in match because of an injury Ariath Piol (Real Salt Lake).
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. Ariath Piol replaces Morgan Guilavogui because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Zach Booth (Real Salt Lake).
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. Aiden Hezarkhani replaces Ariath Piol because of an injury.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Snyder Brunell replaces Hassani Dotson.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Paul Rothrock replaces Nouhou Tolo.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Peter Kingston replaces Jesús Ferreira.
Substitution, Real Salt Lake. DeAndre Yedlin replaces Zach Booth because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Andrew Thomas (Seattle Sounders FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Seattle Sounders FC. Yeimar Gómez replaces Alex Roldan because of an injury.
Second Half ends, Seattle Sounders FC 1, Real Salt Lake 1.
Penalty Shootout ends, Seattle Sounders FC 1(2), Real Salt Lake 1(4).
